messages.text: Monday, September 28 · Canton, Michigan
Autumn air, a full moon rising, and local histories on display
A partly cloudy autumn day offers a high near 76°F. Local history is on display in Ypsilanti, while science explores the early assembly of our own galaxy.
Expect partly cloudy skies today with a high near 76°F and a low around 51°F.
Sunrise is at 7:28 AM, sunset at 7:20 PM, with a full moon 96.9% illuminated.
Local happenings and cultural notes

In Ypsilanti, the YDL-Superior is featuring the Ypsi Farmers & Gardeners Oral History Exhibit, offering a free look at local food growers. For music lovers, Spiral Galaxy performs at Trinosophes in Detroit at 7:30 PM.
Mark your calendar for September 30, which is My Birthday and Patrick's Birthday.
Ann Arbor's fiscal plans and U-M's cancer research

Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for funds from a downtown property sale, allocating $14.2 million to $17.4 million across 12 projects. The University of Michigan has also established a $10 million center to advance soundwave cancer treatments.
Tomorrow's events and learning opportunities
Tomorrow offers a fireside chat on Black Reading Month at Howard Family Bookstore in Detroit at 6 PM, and an interactive workshop on AI for everyday use at Farmington Library at 6 PM.
Space telescope finds ancient galactic collision

NASA's Hubble telescope has identified evidence of an ancient collision with a dwarf galaxy that shaped the Milky Way's early assembly. Additionally, NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation in orbit.
The next Starship orbital flight attempt is estimated no earlier than September 18, 2026.
A quiet afternoon can hold a universe of discovery.
Tuesday, September 29 · Canton, Michigan
Overcast skies meet a day of local discovery
Tuesday brings an overcast sky with a warm high, perfect for engaging with local events. Consider exploring AI tools at the library or a film premiere in Detroit.
Expect an overcast day with a high near 76°F and a low around 51°F.
Sunrise is at 7:29 AM and sunset is at 7:19 PM, with the moon in a waning gibbous phase, 91.9% illuminated.
Explore local happenings and learning

The Farmington Library offers an interactive workshop on AI for the Everyday at 6:00 PM. In Detroit, the Charles H. Wright Museum of African American History hosts the premiere of the film Etched In Pavement at 7:00 PM.
Tomorrow marks My Birthday and Patrick's Birthday.
Ann Arbor plans to spend millions from downtown property sale
Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for the projected $14.2 million to $17.4 million from the sale of the Kline’s lot. The funds will be allocated to 12 different projects.
Tomorrow brings music and community events
Wednesday offers a Plants and Pride event at 11:00 AM in Livonia, and a free food hub discussion at 6:00 PM in Ann Arbor.
NASA's Starling satellites navigate without GPS

NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and a catalog of space objects. Additionally, the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has cleared its flight-readiness review, targeting an August 30 launch.
The next Starship launch attempt is estimated no earlier than September 18, 2026.
Seek out a moment of quiet interest to fill your afternoon.
